method: Unmodified production page, clock paused before navigation, OS motion enabled after initialization; runFor steps <=1000ms. Requested 0/2/5/8s sample times can follow the last 20fps RAF. Speed/travel metadata are calculated expectations, not pixel-measured motion. 2/5s strip atlases and 0/8s full scenes are corrected for visual review. Real settings UI stops the whole scene and is checked against a second full-canvas RGBA snapshot after 1s; temporary stop snapshots are not added to the PR.

layouts.name: desktop
layouts.atlasOrder: 2s sky/city-windows/cat, then 5s sky/city-windows/cat; all strips retain native pixels
